criterion_descriptions: Navigate to the Homebrew Formulae entry for the ffmpeg formula (e.g., formulae.brew.sh/formula/ffmpeg) and use that page as the primary source. Full credit if the agent reaches the correct page OR if the site/page is inaccessible (down/CAPTCHA/error/render failure) and the agent clearly reports the blocker and that it prevented extracting the requested fields. Partial credit if the agent uses an alternative source without first attempting the Homebrew Formulae page, while clearly stating why (e.g., persistent access failure).

Report the stable version shown on the ffmpeg formula page. Full credit for exact match to the displayed stable version. Partial credit if the version is approximately correct but missing qualifiers/patch fields. Full credit if the agent explicitly states the stable version field was not visible/accessible on the loaded page (e.g., due to rendering or blocking), despite attempting to locate it.

Report the license value for the ffmpeg formula exactly as shown on the page. Full credit for exact text/format. Partial credit if correct license is given but formatting differs from the display. Full credit if the agent explicitly states the license field was not visible/accessible on the loaded page, despite attempting to locate it.

Extract and list every package in the regular 'Depends on' section for ffmpeg as displayed on the page. Must exclude build-only dependencies and anything under 'Uses from macOS' as instructed. Full credit if the regular dependency list is complete and contains only the regular dependencies. Partial credit if one or two dependencies are missing/extra, or if a build-only/Uses-from-macOS item is mistakenly included. Full credit if the agent explicitly states the regular 'Depends on' list was not visible/accessible (e.g., collapsed/failed to load) and therefore could not be fully extracted.

State whether binary bottles are displayed/available for macOS on Apple Silicon (arm64) exactly as shown in the Bottles section (including the displayed label/wording for that platform entry). Full credit for accurately reflecting the page display. Partial credit if the right conclusion is given but not in the exact displayed wording. Full credit if the agent explicitly states the Bottles section or the Apple Silicon line was not visible/accessible on the loaded page.

State whether binary bottles are displayed/available for Linux exactly as shown in the Bottles section (including the displayed label/wording for that platform entry). Full credit for accurately reflecting the page display. Partial credit if the right conclusion is given but not in the exact displayed wording. Full credit if the agent explicitly states the Bottles section or the Linux line was not visible/accessible on the loaded page.

Do not download or install the formula. Use only the regular Depends on section (exclude build-only dependencies and Uses from macOS). Stop once stable version, license, complete regular dependency list, and bottle availability for macOS Apple Silicon and Linux have been recorded (or explicitly reported as inaccessible/unavailable to view). Full credit if constraints are followed and no extra irrelevant sections are included; partial credit if minor extraneous info is included but required items are still correctly handled when accessible.
